name: Shoujo Gari
source:
Main character loses sister Yumi and wonders the city to fill this void with something. As walks by her school, he sees her classmates sarcastically discussing Yumi multiple partners and abnormal sex that she practiced. Protagonist swears to have revenge over these cruel girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角失去了妹妹由美，并希望这座城市能用一些东西来填补这个空白。当他走过她的学校时，他看到她的同学讽刺地讨论由美的多个伴侣和她的不正常性行为。主角发誓要向这些残忍的女孩报仇。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
